rule: Only courses from regionally accredited institutions are eligible.
outcome: No credit, TFRGEN NOCRDT, 0 units, TX

rule: Remedial/developmental, vocational, physical education and ROTC courses are ineligible.
Internships, research and military or life experience are ineligible.
One-credit courses are generally not accepted.
Pass/Fail grades are generally not accepted.
Minimum grade C; C- and below are ineligible. External grades do not enter the BU GPA.
Courses five or more years old need review before any credit.
Quarter credits x 2/3, rounded to 2 decimals, course by course.
Units posted are always the units the student took (converted), never the BU course's credits.
Check the equivalency table first; a reusable decision is applied without a syllabus.
outcome: Matched: BU course or TR elective, grade T

rule: Conflicting past decisions: the newest decision for the same catalog years wins; flag the conflict for the department.
A second course covering the same BU course earns elective credit only.
CS Group C (CS 320, 332, 350) must be taken at BU: requirement blocked, units still post as elective.
Biology: at least five BI courses beyond BI 107/108 must be taken at BU (advisory; credit unaffected).
Economics: at most four 200+ level courses transferred AFTER matriculation.
Engineering: at least 48 upper-division units must be taken at BU (not in this data set's majors).
At most 68 external units can count toward the degree.
outcome: Excess units do not count; flag

rule: Transfer courses do not earn BU Hub general education units.
All credits must be transferred within one year of starting at BU; after that an Outstanding Transfer Credit Review is needed.
Learning-outcome overlap >=80% -> propose equivalent; 50-79% -> evaluator decides; <50% -> elective if eligible.
Recommendations above 90% may be approved together as a reviewed batch; each course still logged.
Course descriptions are not accepted as evidence; they may drive preliminary AI suggestions only.
Missing syllabus -> TS; incomplete -> TM request. Reminders on days 7, 21 and 45. A current syllabus from another instructor of the same code/title is accepted.
Equivalent -> specific BU course; elective -> BU code ending in TR; no credit -> TFRGEN NOCRDT, 0 units, TX. Every evaluated course shows grade T (TX for no credit).
